body: Final API: PairingDesign.allOrdered/crossRun/forwardOnly now take a fourth PartitionIndependenceDeclaration[S,S]. Tests can build it with PartitionIndependenceTestSupport.declareAllPairs(source.identity, namedPartitions, id) after constructing the exact PartitionedRelations source. Please update the two reserved RunwiseRelationsSuite calls accordingly.
